visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a bright yellow t-shirt with stylized graphic icons stands in a brightly lit indoor living space. He holds a black bag of 'Stacy's' chips in his left hand and a single chip in his right. He speaks directly to the camera with high facial animation. (2) The camera cuts to another man with glasses wearing a blue and white checkered shirt. He stands with his arms crossed over his chest, looking towards the first man with a calm, slightly amused expression. The background features several framed illustrations on the wall. (3) The scene cuts back to the man in the yellow shirt, who opens his mouth wide and performs exaggerated breathing motions, tilting his head back while still holding the chip and the bag. (4) A rapid sequence of cuts oscillates between the two men, focusing on their contrasting reactions; the man in the yellow shirt continues his exaggerated breathing while the man in the checkered shirt eventually covers his nose with his hand, looking repulsed. (5) The man in the checkered shirt reveals a small, sleek black and white spray bottle. He holds it up to the camera. (6) In a bathroom setting, a hand is seen holding a similar small bottle over a sink. Water runs from a chrome faucet into a small dark cap. The bottle is sprayed once or twice into the cap. (7) Back in the living area, the man in the checkered shirt holds up various oral care products: a white tube of toothpaste and a black and white toothbrush. He gestures towards them while speaking. (8) The video concludes with the man in the checkered shirt showing a bundle of products on a table, including mouth spray, mouthwash, and toothpaste in a ceramic holder.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal male vocal (Voice A) speaking quickly and enthusiastically, punctuated by crisp rustling sounds from a snack bag. An upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic guitar and soft drum rhythm BGM starts immediately. (2) Voice A emits loud, breathy huffs ('ha ha ha') which are rhythmically aligned. (3) A second, calmer male voice (Voice B) enters, speaking in a friendly, helpful tone. A distinct 'psst psst' digital sound effect simulates a spray bottle. Voice A reacts with a comical cough and surprised exclamation. (4) The BGM maintains a steady, happy vibe as Voice B explains product details with clear articulation. (5) Sound of running water and a focused 'plop' effect occur during a bathroom demonstration scene. (6) The video ends with a summary from Voice B, his speech density high and tone persuasive, as the BGM swells slightly before a final digital 'pop' sound effect.
